scripts.install-all: NODE_ENV=development npm install && cd backend && NODE_ENV=development npm install
scripts.build:web: cd apps/mobile && NODE_ENV=development npx expo export -p web
scripts.deploy:web:dev: npm run build:web && firebase deploy --only hosting:dev
scripts.deploy:web:prod: npm run build:web && firebase deploy --only hosting:prod
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix apps/mobile && npm run lint --prefix backend
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix apps/mobile && npm run test --workspace @gymli/shared
scripts.dev:mobile: cd apps/mobile && NODE_ENV=development npx expo start --web
scripts.build:android:dev: cd apps/mobile && NODE_ENV=development npx eas build -p android --profile development
scripts.build:android:prod: cd apps/mobile && NODE_ENV=development npx eas build -p android --profile production
scripts.update:dev: cd apps/mobile && npx eas update --channel development
scripts.update:prod: cd apps/mobile && npx eas update --channel production
